test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Keep someone at arm’s length
solution:
The correct answer is "**Avoid becoming friendly with someone.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An Idiom means an expression whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words in it.
 
 
• Example: "Under the weather" means feeling ill or sick.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "keep someone at arm's length" means to maintain a certain distance or reserve in one's relationship with someone.**
 
• The phrase can be used both literally and figuratively, depending on the context.
 
• In the given question, the correct option is to avoid becoming friendly with someone, which aligns with the meaning of the idiom.
 
• The meanings given in option 2, 3 and 4 are not the correct interpretation of the given phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
